fn generate(numRows: Int) -> List[List[Int]]
  requires (numRows >= 0)
  ensures (len(result) == numRows)
  ensures ((not (numRows == 0)) or (result == []))
  ensures ((not (numRows > 0)) or (forall i in 0..len(result): (len(result[i]) == (i + 1))))
  ensures ((not (numRows > 0)) or (forall i in 0..len(result): ((result[i][0] == 1) and (result[i][(len(result[i]) - 1)] == 1))))
  ensures ((not (numRows > 1)) or (forall i in 1..len(result): forall j in 1..(len(result[i]) - 1): (result[i][j] == (result[(i - 1)][(j - 1)] + result[(i - 1)][j]))))
  effects pure
  example (generate(0) == [])
